highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.154.0 preview updates the bundled renderer to Skia milestone m154.
highlights_body: HarfBuzzSharp generation now follows the exact native source bundled through Skia.

breaking.title: UnicodeCombiningClass.CCC133 was renamed
breaking.body: Use UnicodeCombiningClass.CCC132 instead of CCC133. The numeric value remains 132, but the managed name now matches upstream HarfBuzz.

breaking.title: GlyphFlags.Defined was removed
breaking.body: Combine the concrete glyph flags required by your code instead of using the aggregate Defined member.

bullets.detail: Preview consumers receive the current m154 upstream renderer.

preview_summaries.v4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9: Preview 1 opens the 4.154 line with the Skia m154 engine update.
